diagnosis: Postoperative respiratory failure after major abdominal surgery.
notes: ABG shows type 1 respiratory failure with mild hypoxaemia and compensated metabolic acidosis; oxygen therapy titrated accordingly.
description: ABG analysis for postoperative respiratory failure.

diagnosis: Perioperative acid-base assessment during prolonged major surgery.
notes: Intraoperative ABG shows mild metabolic acidosis with adequate compensation; guided intraoperative fluid and ventilatory adjustment.
description: Perioperative ABG for acid-base assessment.

diagnosis: Critically ill surgical patient in the surgical ICU requiring ABG monitoring.
notes: Serial ABG monitoring shows evolving mixed acid-base disturbance; ventilator settings adjusted based on trend.
description: ABG monitoring in a critically ill surgical ICU patient.

diagnosis: Intraoperative hemodynamic monitoring during major abdominal surgery.
notes: Multiparameter monitor readings (ECG, NIBP, SpO2, EtCO2) reviewed continuously; transient hypotension during induction corrected with fluid bolus and vasopressor.
description: Intraoperative hemodynamic monitoring during major surgery.

diagnosis: Postoperative critical-care monitoring after major surgery.
notes: Continuous monitor readings in the surgical ICU reviewed for heart rate, blood pressure, SpO2, and urine output trends; findings consistent with stable postoperative recovery.
description: Postoperative critical-care monitoring.

diagnosis: Perioperative vital-signs assessment in an elderly surgical patient.
notes: Monitor readings reviewed throughout the perioperative period, showing stable vital signs apart from a brief episode of bradycardia responding to atropine.
description: Perioperative vital-signs assessment.

diagnosis: Major abdominal surgery requiring central venous access for perioperative monitoring.
notes: Central venous catheter inserted via the right internal jugular vein under ultrasound guidance; position confirmed and secured.
description: Central venous catheterization for major abdominal surgery.

diagnosis: Hemodynamic monitoring in a critically ill surgical patient with septic shock.
notes: Central venous catheter inserted via the subclavian route for CVP monitoring and vasopressor administration.
description: Central venous catheterization for hemodynamic monitoring.

diagnosis: Critically ill postoperative patient requiring reliable central access for inotropic support.
notes: Central venous catheter inserted via the right internal jugular vein using a Seldinger technique under aseptic precautions; confirmed with chest X-ray.
description: Central venous catheterization for inotropic support access.

diagnosis: Can't-intubate-can't-ventilate emergency during induction of anaesthesia.
notes: Emergency cricothyroidotomy performed to secure the airway after failed intubation and failed ventilation; airway secured and ventilation established.
description: Emergency cricothyroidotomy for failed airway.

diagnosis: General anaesthesia induction for major abdominal surgery.
notes: Endotracheal intubation performed under direct laryngoscopy following induction of general anaesthesia; tube position confirmed with capnography and bilateral air entry.
description: Endotracheal intubation for general anaesthesia induction.

diagnosis: Elective major abdominal surgery requiring general anaesthesia.
notes: General anaesthesia administered with standard induction agents, muscle relaxant, and maintenance with a volatile agent; patient hemodynamically stable throughout.
description: General anaesthesia for elective major surgery.

competencyItem: Infiltration of local anaesthetics and regional nerve block
diagnosis: Postoperative pain management following limb surgery.
notes: Local anaesthetic infiltrated at the surgical site for postoperative analgesia; patient reported significant pain relief.
description: Local anaesthetic infiltration for postoperative pain management.

competencyItem: Infiltration of local anaesthetics and regional nerve block
diagnosis: Regional nerve block for upper-limb surgery.
notes: Brachial plexus nerve block performed under ultrasound guidance prior to upper-limb surgery, providing effective intraoperative and postoperative analgesia.
description: Regional nerve block for upper-limb surgery.

competencyItem: Infiltration of local anaesthetics and regional nerve block
diagnosis: Regional nerve block for lower-limb surgery in a patient with comorbid cardiac disease.
notes: Femoral nerve block performed under ultrasound guidance to reduce systemic anaesthetic requirement in a patient with significant cardiac comorbidity.
description: Regional nerve block for lower-limb surgery.

competencyItem: Infusion/ syringe pump of fluids, nutrients and medications
diagnosis: Perioperative fluid management during major abdominal surgery.
notes: Syringe pump used for titrated infusion of vasopressor medication intraoperatively; fluid infusion managed with a volumetric pump guided by hemodynamic response.
description: Perioperative fluid and medication infusion management.

competencyItem: Infusion/ syringe pump of fluids, nutrients and medications
diagnosis: Critically ill surgical patient requiring titrated inotropic infusion.
notes: Syringe pump used for continuous titrated infusion of inotropic support in the surgical ICU, with dose adjusted according to blood pressure response.
description: Titrated inotropic infusion in a critically ill surgical patient.

competencyItem: Infusion/ syringe pump of fluids, nutrients and medications
diagnosis: Postoperative parenteral nutrition support after major gastrointestinal surgery.
notes: Infusion pump used to deliver parenteral nutrition and maintenance fluids at a controlled rate via central venous access.
description: Infusion pump for postoperative parenteral nutrition.

diagnosis: Short elective surgical procedure under general anaesthesia with LMA airway management.
notes: Laryngeal mask airway inserted after induction of general anaesthesia; adequate seal confirmed and spontaneous ventilation maintained throughout the procedure.
description: Laryngeal mask airway insertion for short elective surgery.

diagnosis: Spinal anaesthesia for lower-limb orthopaedic surgery.
notes: Spinal anaesthesia administered via the L3-L4 interspace with adequate sensory and motor block achieved for the surgery.
description: Spinal anaesthesia for lower-limb surgery.

diagnosis: Spinal anaesthesia for pelvic surgery in an elderly patient.
notes: Spinal anaesthesia administered with careful dose titration in view of the patient's age; stable hemodynamics maintained throughout the procedure.
description: Spinal anaesthesia for pelvic surgery.

diagnosis: Epidural anaesthesia for major abdominal surgery.
notes: Epidural catheter sited at the appropriate thoracic level with a test dose confirming correct placement; used for intraoperative anaesthesia and postoperative analgesia.
description: Epidural anaesthesia for major abdominal surgery.

diagnosis: Prolonged mechanical ventilation in a surgical ICU patient.
notes: Percutaneous tracheostomy performed at the bedside under bronchoscopic guidance for a patient requiring prolonged ventilatory support.
description: Tracheostomy for prolonged mechanical ventilation.

diagnosis: Difficult ventilator weaning requiring tracheostomy.
notes: Surgical tracheostomy performed to facilitate ventilator weaning and reduce sedation requirements in a critically ill surgical patient.
description: Tracheostomy for difficult ventilator weaning.

diagnosis: Prolonged mechanical ventilation after major surgery with failed extubation attempts.
notes: Percutaneous dilatational tracheostomy performed under bronchoscopic guidance after repeated failed extubation attempts.
description: Tracheostomy after failed extubation attempts.
